misconceptions.name: 看首字母不看读音选 a/an
misconceptions.why: 只记住“元音字母前用 an”，没注意要看第一个音。
misconceptions.move: 把字母名读出来：F 读 /ef/，第一个音是元音，所以说 an F。

misconceptions.name: 把 he 当成“他的”
misconceptions.why: 汉语口语说“他名字叫……”，就把 he 直接放在名词前。
misconceptions.move: 板书两列：I—my，you—your，he—his，she—her，问：名词前用哪一列？

misconceptions.name: 以为 He's 是“他的”
misconceptions.why: He's 和 his 读音相近，又见过 Tom's 表示“汤姆的”。
misconceptions.move: 把 He's 还原成 He is 放回句子：He is name is Mike，通吗？

misconceptions.name: these 后的名词没变复数
misconceptions.why: 汉语名词没有单复数变化，“这些是我的哥哥”里“哥哥”不变。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 these，问：几个人？名词要不要加 s？

misconceptions.name: these 后面仍用 is
misconceptions.why: This is 说熟了，换成 these 时 be 动词没跟着变。
misconceptions.move: 板书配对 this is / these are，让学生当场把三句单数句改成复数句。

misconceptions.name: 把 my 单独用在句末
misconceptions.why: my 和 mine 都译成“我的”，没分清 my 后面必须跟名词。
misconceptions.move: 追问：my 什么？后面没有名词时用 mine，mine = my ruler。

misconceptions.name: 把 me 当成“我的”
misconceptions.why: 常说 It's me（是我），就以为它也能表示“是我的”。
misconceptions.move: 对比两句：It's me.（是我）It's mine.（是我的）让学生各译成中文。

misconceptions.name: 把复数名词当成单数
misconceptions.why: 没注意 keys 词尾的 s，按一样东西来问、来答。
misconceptions.move: 先圈出 keys，问：几把钥匙？几样东西问用 are，答用 they。

misconceptions.name: 回答复数东西也用 it
misconceptions.why: 以为 it 就是“它”，问什么东西都用 It's 回答。
misconceptions.move: 问：keys 是一样东西还是几样？几样东西用 they 指代：They're…

misconceptions.name: does 后的动词还用三单
misconceptions.why: 记住了主语三单要变，用了 does 后动词又变了一次。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生：does 已经表示了三单，后面的动词回到原形：has → have。

misconceptions.name: 泛指可数名词用了单数
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我喜欢香蕉”里名词不变，不知道泛指一类要用复数。
misconceptions.move: 问：你喜欢的是“一根香蕉”，还是“香蕉这种水果”？泛指一类用 bananas。

misconceptions.name: 不可数名词也加了 s
misconceptions.why: 把“名词复数加 s”用到了所有名词上。
misconceptions.move: 分两栏写：能一个一个数的（banana、egg），不能直接数的（bread、milk、rice）。

misconceptions.name: 问价钱用了 how many
misconceptions.why: 钱要“数”，就以为问多少钱用 how many。
misconceptions.move: 对比：How many shorts?（几条）How much are the shorts?（多少钱）

misconceptions.name: 把 shorts 当成一件用单数
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“一条短裤”，就以为 shorts 是单数。
misconceptions.move: 指出 shorts、trousers、socks 词尾都有 s，问：后面用 is 还是 are？

misconceptions.name: 序数词直接在词尾加 th
misconceptions.why: 只记住“加 th”，没记住 nine、twelve 等要先改拼写。
misconceptions.move: 板书特殊变化：nine → ninth（去 e），twelve → twelfth（ve 变 f），five → fifth。

misconceptions.name: 看到 afternoon 就用 in
misconceptions.why: 背熟了 in the afternoon，没注意具体某一天的下午用 on。
misconceptions.move: 对比：in the afternoon / on Friday afternoon，问：有没有说具体哪一天？

misconceptions.name: 听到 your name 就报出名字
misconceptions.why: 只听懂了句尾熟悉的 your name，没注意 spell 是“拼写”。
misconceptions.move: 把 spell 写在黑板上读成“拼”，请一位学生把自己的英文名一个字母一个字母地拼出来。

misconceptions.name: 看到紧挨着的 I 就用 am
misconceptions.why: 只记住“I 后面用 am”，没看出主语是“我的朋友和我”两个人。
misconceptions.move: 用手圈出整个主语 My friend and I，问：几个人？两个人就是 we，we 后面用什么？

misconceptions.name: 只看 my friend 就用 is
misconceptions.why: 主语开头的 my friend 是一个人，就按单数配了 is，没看后面还有 and I。
misconceptions.move: 把主语换成代词再说：My friend and I = We，We ____ 13. 学生自己就会说 are。

misconceptions.name: 以为 across from 是旁边
misconceptions.why: across from 和 next to 都表示两处离得近，没分清是并排还是面对面。
misconceptions.move: 请两位同学隔着过道面对面站：这是 across from；再并肩站：这是 next to。

misconceptions.name: 以为 across from 是穿过
misconceptions.why: 先学过 go across the road（穿过马路），一看到 across 就想到“穿过”。
misconceptions.move: 问：句子里有人在走路吗？没有，across from 说的是一个固定的位置——“在……对面”。

misconceptions.name: 两句话一连就用 and
misconceptions.why: and 学得最早，以为连接两句话都用它，没看前后意思是顺着还是相反。
misconceptions.move: 先让学生判断前后两句是“顺着说”还是“转过来说”：难→很喜欢，是转过来，用 but。

misconceptions.name: 没看哪句是原因就用 because
misconceptions.why: 说惯了 I like ... because ...，一见到 like 就套用 because。
misconceptions.move: 把两半句拆开问：“我很喜欢它”是“科学难”的原因吗？不是原因，就不能用 because。

misconceptions.name: 动词后面的“我们”还用 we
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我们”放在哪都一样，没想到放在 lets 后面要用宾格 us。
misconceptions.move: 板书两列 I—me，we—us，he—him，she—her，问：lets 后面这个词跟在动词后，用哪一列？

misconceptions.name: 介词 at 后直接用动词原形
misconceptions.why: 汉语“擅长做饭”里“做”不变形，就把 cook 原样放在 at 后面。
misconceptions.move: 板书 good at English / good at cooking，问：at 后面放的是名词，动词怎样才能像名词？加 -ing。

misconceptions.name: 以为“擅长做”要接 to do
misconceptions.why: 学过 want to do、like to do，就以为两个动作之间都加 to。
misconceptions.move: 对比 want to make / good at making，问：前面是 at 还是动词？at 是介词，后面接 -ing。

misconceptions.name: 把 past 和 to 的意思记反
misconceptions.why: past、to 都是新学的，只记住要用其中一个，没记住 past 是“过”、to 是“差”。
misconceptions.move: 在钟面上画一条竖线：分针在右半边（刚过整点）说 past，在左半边（快到下一个整点）说 to。

misconceptions.name: 照“两点过一刻”的语序说时间
misconceptions.why: 照汉语先说钟点再说分钟，把 two 放在了最前面。
misconceptions.move: 板书英语的顺序：分钟 + past/to + 钟点，让学生把 two 移到最后再读一遍。

misconceptions.name: 看到月份就用 in
misconceptions.why: 背熟了 in May、in October，没注意具体到哪一天就要用 on。
misconceptions.move: 对比 in October / on 9th October，问：说到具体哪一天了吗？说到某一天就用 on。

items.lesson: Section A How do you greet people?
lessons: How do you greet people
Starter Unit 1 Pronunciation
items.topic: 字母前用 a 还是 an
items.stem: 字母前用 a 还是 an？依次填空：____ F，____ U，____ H
right: 看第一个音，不看字母：F /ef/、H /eɪtʃ/ 以元音开头，用 an；
U /juː/ 以辅音 /j/ 开头，用 a。
typical: F、H 不是元音字母，用 a；U 是元音字母，用 an

ladder.q: 填 a 或 an：____ orange，____ ruler
填 a 或 an：____ hour，____ UFO

items.lesson: Section A How do we get to know each other?
lessons: How do we get to know each other
items.stem: This is my friend. ____ name is Mike.
right: name 前要用形容词性物主代词：he → his。
His name is Mike.（他的名字叫迈克。）
typical: He's 就像 Tom's，表示“他的”：

ladder.q: ____ (she) name is Gina.
—What's ____ (you) name? —____ (I) name is Tom.
填 He's 或 His：____ my brother. ____ name is Bob.

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
lessons: What is your family like
items.stem: 向同学介绍你的两个哥哥，哪句对？
right: these 指两个以上：be 动词用 are，
名词也要用复数：These are my brothers.
typical: “这些是我的哥哥”，“哥哥”不用变：

ladder.q: Those ____ (be) my parents.
These are my ____ (sister).
改成复数句：This is my friend.

items.lesson: Section B Where do you put your things?
lessons: Where do you put your things
items.stem: —Where ____ my keys? —____ on the sofa.
right: keys 是复数：问句用 are，
答句用 they 指代：They're on the sofa.
typical: 问句用了 are，答句还是 It's：
—Where are my keys? —It's on the sofa.

ladder.q: Where ____ (be) your books?
—Where's my hat? —____ on the bed.
—Where are your pencils? —____ in my pencil box.

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
lessons: What is your family like
items.stem: 小明把 He has a soccer ball. 改成一般疑问句。他从第几步开始错？
work: 句中没有 be 动词，要借助助动词 do
主语 he 是三单，用 Does，放在句首
has 照抄：Does he has a soccer ball?
回答：Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
right: 用了 Does，后面的动词还原成原形：has → have。
Does he have a soccer ball?

ladder.q: ____ your sister ____ (have) a tennis ball?
改成一般疑问句：Jim likes bananas.
改成否定句：Lucy has a ping-pong bat.
ladder.a: Lucy doesn't have a ping-pong bat.

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
lessons: How do we celebrate birthdays
items.stem: 想问“这条短裤多少钱”，哪句对？
right: 问价钱用 How much；
shorts 总是复数形式，要用 these 和 are。

ladder.q: How much ____ (be) the green sweater?
—How much are the socks? —____ two dollars.
How much ____ (be) this pair of trousers?

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
lessons: How do we celebrate birthdays
items.stem: 写出序数词：nine → ____，twelve → ____
right: nine 去掉 e 再加 th：ninth；
twelve 把 ve 变成 f 再加 th：twelfth。
typical: 序数词就是在后面加 th：nineth，twelveth

ladder.q: five → ____
twenty → ____
写成单词：22nd，31st

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.topic: 时间介词 in 与 on
items.stem: 小红说下面这句话写得对。你同意吗？
work: We have P.E. on Friday afternoon.
right: 说具体某一天的上午、下午、晚上用 on，
on Friday afternoon 没错，小红说得对。

ladder.q: We have music ____ Monday.
I do my homework ____ the evening.
The school trip is ____ the morning of May 2nd.

items.lesson: Section A What do you have?
lessons: What do you have
Starter Unit 2 Pronunciation
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: cap 后面加上 e，就成了 cape。
e 不发音，所以 a 的读音不变。
right: 结尾的 e 不发音，但它让前面的 a 读字母 A 的名字。
cap 里的 a 和 cat 一样；cape 里的 a 和 cake、name 一样。

ladder.q: 圈出 a 读字母 A 名字的词：cat　cake　bag　name
哪个词里的 a 和 face 里的 a 读音一样：bag　make　hand
用拼读规则读生词 gate：a 像 cat 里的，还是像 cake 里的？

items.lesson: Section B What do you like about your family?
lessons: What do you like about your family
items.stem: “她是长头发。”哪句对？
right: 描述头发用 have/has；
hair 指一头头发时不可数：She has long hair.

ladder.q: My brother ____ short curly hair.
My father ____ tall and he ____ a big nose.
—What does she look like? —She's thin and ____ (wear) glasses.

items.lesson: Section A What is your school like?
lessons: What is your school like
items.stem: 小明想说“我家附近有一个公园”。他这样写，你同意吗？
work: There has a park near my home.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there be，不用 have/has：
There is a park near my home.

ladder.q: ____ ____ a bank on Green Street.
—____ ____ any restaurants near here? —Yes, there are.
My town ____ (have) two big parks.

items.lesson: Section A How do you choose a school club?
lessons: How do you choose a school club
items.stem: My sister ____ the piano very well.
right: can 是情态动词，没有人称变化，
后面直接跟动词原形：can play。
typical: 主语 my sister 是三单，动词加 s：
My sister can plays the piano.

ladder.q: He can ____ (swim) very well.
改成一般疑问句：Tom can speak English.
—Can your brother play chess? —No, he ____.

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom usually ____ (go) to school at 7:30 and ____ (watch) TV after dinner.
right: 主语 Tom 是三单，动词要变；
以 o、ch 结尾的加 es：goes，watches。
typical: “他去上学”和“我去上学”一样，不用变：go，watch

ladder.q: She ____ (do) her homework at six.
My father ____ (have) breakfast at 7:00.
Tom and his brother ____ (brush) their teeth at 9:00.

items.lesson: Section B How do you start a conversation?
lessons: How do you start a conversation
items.stem: 你叫 Lucy。新同学问：How do you spell your name? 你怎么回答？
right: How do you spell ...? 问的是“怎么拼写”，
要一个字母一个字母地拼出来：L-U-C-Y, Lucy.
typical: 听到 your name，就回答名字：

ladder.q: 给问句选答语：What's your name?　A. P-E-T-E-R.　B. I'm Peter.
—How do you spell "Lily"? —____
补全问句：—____ ____ ____ ____ your name? —G-R-E-E-N, Green.

items.lesson: Section A What is fun in a yard?
lessons: What is fun in a yard
Starter Unit 3 Pronunciation
items.topic: not 和 note 里的 o
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: note 和 not 里都有字母 o，
所以 o 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/。
right: not 里 o 后面只跟一个辅音、没有 e，o 读短音 /ɒ/；
note 词尾有不发音的 e，o 才读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/。

ladder.q: 圈出 o 读 /ɒ/ 的词：box　joke　hot　home
哪个词里的 i 和 big 里的 i 读音一样：nine　six　like
用拼读规则读生词 hop 和 hope：o 各读什么？

items.lesson: Section B What is fun on a farm?
lessons: What is fun on a farm
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：On the farm, I can see six ____ (sheep) and ten ____ (cow).
right: sheep 单复数同形，几只都写 sheep；
cow 是规则变化，复数加 s：cows。

ladder.q: two ____ (duck) and three ____ (horse)
many ____ (sheep) and some ____ (chicken)
five ____ (child) and twenty ____ (sheep)

items.lesson: Section B What do we need to know about a new friend?
lessons: What do we need to know about a new friend
items.topic: 并列主语后的 be 动词
items.stem: 回帖介绍自己和朋友：My friend and I ____ both 13 years old.
right: My friend and I 是两个人，相当于 we，
be 动词用 are：My friend and I are both 13 years old.
typical: My friend and I am both 13 years old.

ladder.q: Lily and Lucy ____ (be) from the UK.
My cousin and I ____ (be) from Xi'an.
改错：My sister and I is good friends.

items.lesson: Section B What fun things do you do at school?
lessons: What fun things do you do at school
items.stem: The science building is across from the library. 这句话的意思是：
options: 穿过图书馆就到科学楼
right: across from 表示“在……对面”，说的是位置：
科学楼和图书馆面对面，中间隔着路或空地。
typical: 所以是：穿过图书馆就到科学楼。

ladder.q: 填 next to 或 across from：我和 Li Ming 并排坐。I sit ____ Li Ming.
体育馆在礼堂对面。The gym is ____ the school hall.
用英语说：图书馆在体育馆和食堂之间。
ladder.a: The library is between the gym and the dining hall.

items.lesson: Section A Why do you like this subject?
lessons: Why do you like this subject
items.stem: Science is hard for me, ____ I like it a lot.
right: “难”和“很喜欢”意思相反，
表示转折用 but：Science is hard for me, but I like it a lot.
typical: Science is hard for me, and I like it a lot.

ladder.q: I like PE ____ it's exciting.
I want to play, ____ I have a lot of homework.
I have PE ____ IT on Friday. I like IT ____ it's fun, ____ PE is my favourite.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn from different subjects?
lessons: What can you learn from different subjects
items.topic: let 后面的代词和动词
items.stem: Our IT teacher ____ the computers after class.
right: lets 后面用宾格 us，再直接接动词原形：
lets us use（让我们用）。
typical: “让我们去用电脑”，两个动词之间加 to：
Our IT teacher lets us to use ...

ladder.q: Let ____ (we) go to the music room.
Our PE teacher lets us ____ (choose) the games.
Mum doesn't let ____ (he) ____ (watch) TV after 9:00.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn in a school club?
lessons: What can you learn in a school club
items.stem: Mia 想加入烹饪社，她写道：I'm good at ____ dumplings.
right: at 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing：
I'm good at making dumplings.

ladder.q: She is good at ____ (swim).
I'm interested in ____ (draw) animals.
Are you good at ____ (run)? Join our running club!

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section B How different are people's daily routines?
lessons: How different are people's daily routines
items.topic: 用 past 和 to 说时间
items.stem: Timo 的下午课 2:15 结束。2:15 用英语怎么说？
right: 英语先说分钟，再说钟点：15 分钟是 a quarter；
刚过 2 点用 past：a quarter past two（也可说 two fifteen）。

ladder.q: 用 past 说 6:30
用 to 说 4:45
Timo 7:40 起床，用 to 说这个时间

items.lesson: Section B How do you make your birthday meaningful?
lessons: How do you make your birthday meaningful
items.topic: 日期前用 on 还是 in
items.stem: 小红在回帖里写了这句话，她说写得对。你同意吗？
right: 说到具体的某一天用 on：on 9th October；
只说月份才用 in：in October。所以小红写得对。

ladder.q: My birthday is ____ May.
Teachers' Day is ____ 10th September.
We eat birthday noodles ____ the morning of my birthday.
